startup_trace.limits: Missing END means no completion was captured, not proof of deadlock. V4 queued logging can drop events or lose its tail on forced restart. Wall time includes scheduling and logging (synchronous SD I/O in v3), not GPU time. Startup trace begins after packet validation and bridge lock acquisition.

progress_trace.limits: Snapshots never acquire the COM gate. V6 samples ordinary calls every 256 entries; critical calls and failures retain detailed state. Totals describe the last sampled completion and idle is not proof that another unsampled call is idle. Missing snapshots may mean scheduling/I/O delay or lost queued output. These are not GPU timings.

limits: COM self-test is a synthetic client, not Sleeping Dogs FPS.
Game Present windows can include menu, loading and pause. Scene/clock matched gameplay validation remains separate.
Logs do not authenticate running binary, clocks or visible scanout.
Renderer config must match COM/game mode. This rejects a game log overwriting COM output but does not authenticate an exact session. Save COM logs before launching the game.
Resource counters are bridge-owned external references/maps; they do not prove all DXVK/driver allocations are freed.
